assertions.assertion: Defines authorization policies that use RequireClaim with 'scope' claim type for 'api1.read' and 'api1.write'
assertions.rationale: The "read" and "write" policies call policy.RequireClaim("scope", "api1.read") and RequireClaim("scope", "api1.write") respectively.

assertions.assertion: Applies the read policy to the GET endpoint and the write policy to the POST endpoint using RequireAuthorization
Implements a custom IClaimsTransformation that splits space-delimited scope claims into individual claims
assertions.rationale: ScopeClaimsTransformation removes a space-delimited scope claim and re-adds each token as an individual scope claim.

assertions.assertion: Registers the IClaimsTransformation implementation in the DI container
